Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent VFX ATLAS for an existing refined Chinese-mythology side-view action game. This is a GAME ASSET SHEET, not a mockup, not a poster, not a concept illustration. Create ONE coherent master atlas with EXACTLY 3 columns and 5 rows (15 isolated effect sprites), equal invisible cells, portrait canvas ideally 1536x2560. All surrounding pixels and all empty cell space must have genuine transparent alpha. Every effect entirely inside its own cell with generous transparent gutters; no overlap, no clipping. The five rows belong to five distinct mythological bosses. Read left-to-right by row:
ROW 1, giant celestial axe boss: (1) powerful broad amber-gold axe swing crescent made of wind, sparks and irregular dust, facing right; (2) violent eruption of uneven three-dimensional broken rock shards rising from below, textured stone strata and warm dust, NOT triangular wireframe spikes; (3) a natural low billowing sand/debris shockwave with scattered little stones, direction right.
ROW 2, underworld judge: (1) an ancient floating magical verdict seal in red cinnabar and smoky violet ink, organic calligraphic strokes without readable text, no enclosing circular UI ring; (2) three loose heavy spectral chains descending from above, uneven curves and little wisps of smoke, no straight cage perimeter; (3) a dramatic spreading ink-and-spirit smoke impact, wispy dark purple tendrils and pale ghostly motes.
ROW 3, nine-headed venom creature: (1) a large asymmetrical toxic glob/projectile with wet highlights and trailing droplets, direction right; (2) a churning poisonous surf crest, muddy jade and yellow-green foam, NOT a rectangular pool or solid color slab; (3) an irregular curling poisonous vapor cloud, translucent ragged edges, enough open holes to see the game behind it.
ROW 4, east sea dragon king: (1) an isolated turbulent dark blue stormcloud bank with faint internal white-blue electric illumination, natural uneven soft silhouette, no scenery; (2) a spectacular tall branching lightning strike descending from TOP to BOTTOM, multiple nonuniform organic forks, brilliant narrow white core and fine electric spray, rich subtle blue falloff, NOT a geometric zigzag line drawing and not a solid blue curtain; (3) a tall powerful turquoise water geyser thrusting UPWARD with turbulent detailed water, white foamy crown and separate flying droplets, no background water or floor plane.
ROW 5, pagoda-bearing celestial king: (1) an ethereal golden seven-tier Chinese pagoda projection with shimmering ornamental roof forms, magical light rather than a solid black building, transparent gaps; (2) multiple loosely flowing golden descending light ribbons and drifting luminous golden motes, softly dissipating, NOT ruler-straight equally-spaced lines, not a rectangular wall; (3) an energetic substantial fire wheel with twisting natural flames, orange-gold tongues and sparks, direction right, no thin vector ring.
STYLE: luxurious, highly finished painterly pixel-cluster fantasy VFX matching detailed Chinese fantasy game sprites, dimensional material and turbulent organic motion. Natural frayed alpha edges, textured irregular light and particulate detail, restrained soft glow only immediately around luminous matter; no uniform colored fog behind each sprite. All assets must read clearly at roughly 80-300 in-game pixels and composite naturally over arbitrary detailed scenery. No actors, UI, terrain, scenery, labels, letters, numbers, panels, grid strokes, cell borders, bounding boxes, outlines around effects, ground lines, rectangular gradients, colored backdrop, black background, white background, or baked checkerboard. Especially avoid the cheap appearance of procedural polygons and straight boundary lines. Genuine transparent background.

For all 15 effects: transparent holes and frayed soft silhouettes, no colored rectangular background, no box edges, no outlines, no UI geometry, no full-cell colored gradient, no labels, no borders, no grid, no checkerboard painted into the image.
